name: What preparations should I make before a handyman arrives?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before a handyman arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a City Dweller, LLC handyman arrives, it's helpful to clear the work area of any obstacles, furniture, or fragile items to allow easy access and ensure safety. If the job involves a specific item, such as a leaky faucet, make sure the area around it is accessible. For tasks requiring materials you've purchased, have them ready. If you have specific instructions or preferences, prepare a brief list or be ready to discuss them upon arrival. This preparation helps our handyman work efficiently and reduces the overall time needed for the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the work area, remove obstacles, and ensure easy access for the handyman. Have any purchased materials ready and prepare specific instructions to facilitate efficient work.
